title: A discovered competitor candidate. Every discovered domain enters as CANDIDATE_COMPETITOR and stays there until a human validates it.

site_id.description: Which registered site this candidate belongs to. Candidates are never shared between sites.

status.description: Discovery can only produce CANDIDATE_COMPETITOR. Only a human moves it to VALIDATED or REJECTED.

category.description: Kept strictly separate. A directory that outranks us is not a business competitor, and conflating them corrupts every gap analysis built on top.

category_rationale.description: Why this category and not another.

evidence.description: At least one concrete observation. A domain never enters on assertion alone.

source.description: Search Console, a licensed provider (named), an AI platform, or a page URL actually read. Never prohibited SERP scraping.

overlap_strength.description: Deliberately coarse. One shared keyword is not competition.

offers_same_service.description: Read from their own site. UNKNOWN until a page was actually read.

validated_by.description: Person who validated or rejected. Absent while status is CANDIDATE_COMPETITOR.
